headline: PG&E Readies Electric System and Crews for Extended Heat and Elevated Wildfire Conditions
summary: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E) is preparing for an extended heat event across inland parts of PG&E's service area, which is expected to begin July 31, and last through August 7, with the hottest temperatures forecast August 1 through August 3.
